goal: Repair canonical VI/EN Tarot semantics, grammar and reflective safety across all 78 cards while preserving identifiers and data structure.
successCriteria: Exactly 78 original canonical IDs and structural metadata remain unchanged; all text is accented UTF-8 VI and natural EN.
Four rank-three cards have distinct suit-specific meanings; Three of Swords reflects heartache without predicting loss.
Each Minor has card-specific upright/reversed meaning and journal question rather than a shared rank template; Page of Wands reversed avoids judging the user.
Review every canonical card for VI/EN parity, grammar, card theme and reflective safety, with per-card evidence in the report.
Data validation plus semantic contrast/duplicate/adversarial checks pass; native/artwork/backend/ledger acceptance remains unverified.
untouchedSurfaces: All seven deck metadata, deck-specific introductions and visual prompts remain untouched.
Artwork, rendered cards, quality ledgers, generated Admin/Supabase/mobile content and apps/mobile/App.tsx are integration work owned by root.
Runtime prompts, providers, schemas, entitlements, private storage and live databases remain untouched.

impact.entryPoint: Canonical meanings appear in Tarot library/detail, immediate draw reveals and reading results; root will run the generated consumers and manager UI path after integration.
impact.dataWrite: Only bilingual canonical JSON text and scoped QC report/plan are edited; no private records, schema changes or live writes.
impact.backendContract: Selected card IDs/orientations and response contracts are unchanged; generated Supabase seed must be refreshed by root without executing a live seed.
impact.adminVisibility: Root regenerates Admin review seed; any content-bundle publish requires separate owner-controlled integration and runtime readback.
impact.privacySafety: Public seed and fictional Tarot scenarios only; interpretation invites agency and avoids predictions, shame, diagnosis or professional instructions.
impact.observability: Record reviewed IDs, changed fields, current content hashes and semantic evidence; no provider trace or actual-output improvement is claimed.
impact.rollback: Revert only this task's scoped text delta, retaining pre-existing modifications; do not rerun legacy generate-tarot-data or reset unrelated files.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json is the sole 78-card canonical roster and meaning source; IDs/shape unchanged.
packages/agent-config/tarot-card-skills.json defines bilingual card-theme, reflection and safety checks; existing edits preserved.

securityReview.authzRls: Content-only local seed edits do not alter authorization or RLS; no database rows or owner credentials are accessed.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only public canonical card data and invented reflection contexts; no chat, journal, birth records or uploads.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No provider keys, tokens or service-role secrets; output only public copy, hashes and test counts.
securityReview.externalInput: Interpretations treat symbols as possibilities, not facts about a user's life; no generated future, motives or diagnosis.
securityReview.dependencies: No install, provider calls, dependency edits or artwork generation. Existing validator and source-only Node checks are used.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No deploy/publish/migration/seed execution; ledger blocked status respected. Changed content resets acceptance hashes; root integrates outputs.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop and return to root if repair requires deck/artwork/private/runtime edits or broader write scope.

validationCommands: Source-only semantic check: rank-three contrasts, distinct 56 Minor orientation meanings, 78 unique questions, safe difficult-card framing and VI/EN thematic evidence.
managerTestPath: After root integration: Explore > Tarot > Classic library > four Three cards, Page of Wands reversed, Eight/Nine of Swords, Six of Pentacles and Knight of Pentacles; switch VI/EN, inspect reveal/result consistency and one usable journal question.
residualRisk: This is canonical editorial review, not independent full-deck artwork acceptance or live model/device proof. Deck-specific intro and saved old readings may still differ until root integration/retest.
